title: feat(varl1): ell1 is worse-round than c2d4 on B12
science: Third leg of the same comparison, on roundness: exact rational second moments on the 2624 nonzero sites of B_12(0) give Q_l1=337/656 and Q_c2d4=12586016761121881939/63482497589871360000, and population variances var_l1=0.009447425719061308 > var_c2d4=0.003574941366936777. The axiom-native l1 cone is strictly LESS Euclidean-round than the engineered rule. Completes the three-way #7010/#7012/#7013 negative: the native cone fails reverse, fails face, and is less round.
verdict_pair: reverse=absent face=absent (reports var_l1 > var_c2d4 on B_12(0))
